app.err.no_url: The tix server URL is not configured; an admin sets it in System Console > Plugins > tix
app.err.not_linked: Your Mattermost account is not connected to tix yet: run `/tix connect`
app.err.tix_401: tix rejected your token (expired or revoked?). Reconnect with `/tix connect`.
app.err.tix_403: tix says you are not allowed to do that: {message}
cards.action.cannot_move: {ref} is {state} now and cannot move to {to} from there.
cards.cmd.sync: Mirror replies in this channel's task card threads to tix comments, and back (channel admins)
cards.cmd.sync_on: Mirror card threads and tix comments
cards.err.dialog: Could not open the comment dialog.
cards.err.not_linked: Connect your Mattermost account to tix first: run `/tix connect`.
cards.err.out_of_date: That card is out of date.
cards.sync.admins_only: Only channel admins can turn thread sync on or off.
cards.sync.not_linked_hint: Replies in this thread are copied to the task in tix, but your account is not connected, so yours was not. Run `/tix connect`.
cards.sync.status_off: Thread sync is off in this channel. Channel admins change it with `/tix sync on|off`.
cards.sync.status_on: Thread sync is on in this channel. Channel admins change it with `/tix sync on|off`.
cards.sync.turned_off: {who} turned tix thread sync off in this channel.
cards.sync.turned_on: {who} turned tix thread sync on in this channel: replies in a task card's thread are added to the task in tix as comments by whoever wrote them, and tix comments on the task are posted into the thread. Everyone who can read this channel sees those comments.
cards.sync.wrong_channel_type: Thread sync works in public and private channels, not direct or group messages.
command.admins_only: Only system admins can run that.
digest.all_clear: All clear: nothing overdue, due today, new, blocked or in progress.
digest.cmd.days_usage: Use `/tix digest days mon-fri` or `/tix digest days daily`.
digest.cmd.digest: Get a daily DM summary of your tix tasks
digest.cmd.digest_on: Send it every workday at this time (default 09:00, your time zone)
digest.cmd.digest_quiet: Skip a digest with nothing to report
digest.cmd.quiet_usage: Use `/tix digest quiet on` or `/tix digest quiet off`.
digest.cmd.read_failed: Could not read your digest settings.
digest.cmd.reminders: Get a DM when a task assigned to you is due today or overdue
digest.cmd.reminders_on: Remind me of due and overdue tasks
digest.cmd.sent: Sent your digest to your DM with @tix.
digest.err.bad_clock: `{value}` is not a time of day; use HH:MM, e.g. 08:30
digest.section.title: {title} ({count})
digest.status.empty_sent: an empty one says All clear
digest.status.off: Your tix digest is **off**. `/tix digest on [HH:MM]` turns it on.
digest.status.reminders_off: Due reminders are **off**. `/tix reminders on` turns them on.
digest.status.reminders_on: Due reminders are **on**: tasks due today in the morning run at {at}, overdue tasks between {from} and {until}.
digest.status.separate: These are separate from `/tix notifications`, which covers DMs about changes to your tasks.
link.cmd.connect: Connect your Mattermost account to tix
link.cmd.disconnect: Disconnect from tix and revoke the token the plugin holds
link.cmd.me: Show the tix account you are connected as
notify.channel.not_allowed: Only people who can manage this channel's settings can change its tix feeds.
notify.channel.wrong_type: tix feeds go into public or private channels, not direct or group messages.
notify.cmd.notifications: Turn your personal tix DMs on or off
notify.cmd.subscribe: Post a project's tix activity in this channel
notify.cmd.subscriptions: List the tix feeds of this channel
notify.cmd.unsubscribe: Stop posting a project's tix activity in this channel
notify.cmd.webhook: Register, check or remove the webhook tix sends events to
notify.cmd.webhook_remove: Remove the plugin's webhook from tix
notify.cmd.webhook_setup: Register or update the plugin's webhook in tix
notify.cmd.webhook_status: Show the webhook and its recent deliveries
notify.notifications.off: Personal tix DMs are off. Channel feeds are not affected.
notify.notifications.on: Personal tix DMs are on: you hear about tasks assigned to you, comments on tasks you are assigned or created, your tasks being closed, and mentions.
notify.notifications.state_off: Your personal tix DMs are **off**. `/tix notifications on|off` changes that.
notify.notifications.state_on: Your personal tix DMs are **on**. `/tix notifications on|off` changes that.
notify.subscribe.all_admins_only: Only system admins can subscribe a channel to every project. Name one project you can see.
notify.subscribe.bad_value: `{option} {value}` is not valid; use one of {allowed}
notify.subscribe.done: This channel now gets tix activity of {project}: {events}.
notify.subscribe.no_project: no project `{project}` among the projects you can see in tix
notify.subscribe.no_webhook: Nothing arrives until a system admin runs `/tix webhook setup`.
notify.subscribe.privacy: Everyone who can read this channel will see the titles and comment text of those tasks, including people who cannot open the project in tix. You chose to publish it here; `/tix unsubscribe` stops it.
notify.subscribe.usage: Usage: `/tix subscribe <project|all> [{events}] [--detail compact|detailed|card] [--comments full|excerpt|none] [--people names|mentions]`. Default: {defaults}.
notify.subscriptions.all_admins_only: Only system admins can list the feeds of every channel.
notify.subscriptions.none: This channel has no tix feeds. `/tix subscribe <project>` adds one.
notify.subscriptions.none_anywhere: No channel has a tix feed.
notify.unsubscribe.done: Stopped that tix feed in this channel.
notify.unsubscribe.none: This channel had no such tix feed. `/tix subscriptions` lists them.
notify.webhook.log_failed: Could not read the delivery log: {error}
notify.webhook.no_admin_token: Set the admin token (with `webhook:admin`) in System Console > Plugins > tix first.
notify.webhook.no_secret: Generate the webhook secret in System Console > Plugins > tix first.
notify.webhook.none: No tix webhook points at this plugin. `/tix webhook setup` registers one.
notify.webhook.none_short: No tix webhook points at this plugin.
notify.webhook.removed: Removed the tix webhook `{id}`. Channel feeds and DMs stop until `/tix webhook setup`.
notify.webhook.secret_unset: The webhook secret is not set, so every delivery is rejected.
tasks.cmd.assign: Assign a task, or unassign it with none
tasks.cmd.assign_who: Who: @user, me, none or a tix handle
tasks.cmd.channel: Show this channel's tix settings; channel admins set its default project for /tix new and the create reaction
tasks.cmd.channel_project: Set or clear this channel's default project (channel admins)
tasks.cmd.close: Close a task without doing it (cancelled state, else done)
tasks.cmd.done: Move a task to its done state
tasks.cmd.due: Your open tasks due today or overdue, soonest first
tasks.cmd.list: List open tasks: yours by default, a project's, or a tix filter such as status:todo tag:ops
tasks.cmd.list_filter: tix filter terms: status:todo tag:ops priority:high @user due:week title~api
tasks.cmd.mine: Your open tasks (same as /tix list mine)
tasks.cmd.mine_filter: tix filter terms: status:todo tag:ops priority:high
tasks.cmd.move: Move a task to a state of its workflow
tasks.cmd.new: Create a task, in the channel's default project unless you name one; the title takes tix quick-add tokens: !high #tag @user due:fri
tasks.cmd.new_project: Project (optional; the channel's default is listed first)
tasks.cmd.reopen: Move a finished task back to an open state
tasks.cmd.search: Full-text search over titles and bodies, finished tasks included unless you add open
tasks.cmd.search_text: Text, then optionally a project, filter terms (status:todo tag:ops @user) and open
tasks.cmd.show: Show a task with its latest comments
tasks.cmd.start: Move a task to its in-progress state
